**Compliant at the preferred position.**

No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binds Juniper Ridge. Section 12.3 affirmatively preserves our freedom to engage any supplier and records that "Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."

Notes on the two adjacent provisions the planner flagged, neither of which is an exclusivity deviation:
- **§ 7.2** (disclose-and-match before engaging another provider) restrains our *pricing leverage*, not our right to procure elsewhere — it belongs under the MFN rule and should not be double-flagged here.
- **§ 2.1** (USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay, no reduction or termination rights) is a minimum-volume commitment, not exclusive dealing. Worth raising separately: it directly contradicts § 12.3's acknowledgement that we made no minimum-volume commitment.
